name: forward_render_static
description: Still frame of the loaded scene on the forward pipeline, FLIP-compared against the published ground truth.

name: deferred_render_static
description: Still frame of the loaded scene on the deferred pipeline, FLIP-compared against the published ground truth.

name: deferred_render_static_emulated
description: The deferred still frame on the android emulator, which renders through the host's software rasterizer and cannot sample ASTC-HDR (textures take the CPU-decode fallback). Its output legitimately sits ~0.022 mean FLIP from the device-captured ground truth (0.007 before HDR compression), so the gate widens to 0.03 - still far below any pipeline breakage.

name: forward_render_static_halfres
description: Still frame on the forward pipeline at render_scale 0.5. The output must stay at full resolution (size mismatch fails the evaluator) and FLIP-match the full-resolution ground truth within an upsampling-softness allowance.

name: gpu_render_static
description: Still frame on the gpu path-tracing pipeline, FLIP-compared against the published ground truth. Converging it is too slow on the software-rendering runners, so it stays local-only; gpu_render_static_64spp gates a partly converged frame in CI.

name: cpu_render_static
description: Still frame on the cpu path-tracing pipeline, FLIP-compared against the published ground truth. Too slow for CI runners, so it stays local-only.

name: cpu_render_static_64spp
description: Still frame on the cpu path-tracing pipeline after 64 samples per pixel, FLIP-compared against the published ground truth. The ground truth is converged, so the gate allows for the remaining sampling noise.

name: gpu_render_static_64spp
description: Still frame on the gpu path-tracing pipeline after 64 samples per pixel, FLIP-compared against the published ground truth. The ground truth is converged, so the gate allows for the remaining sampling noise. Without ray query support the pipeline falls back to forward.

name: forward_sync_validation
description: Forward still frame under the Vulkan validation layer with synchronization validation; any validation error, or a missing layer, fails the case.

name: deferred_sync_validation
description: Deferred still frame under the Vulkan validation layer with synchronization validation; any validation error, or a missing layer, fails the case.

name: gpu_sync_validation
description: A few path-traced samples under the Vulkan validation layer with synchronization validation; any validation error, or a missing layer, fails the case. Without ray query support the pipeline falls back to forward, which the evaluator rejects.

name: cpu_sync_validation
description: One cpu path-traced sample under the Vulkan validation layer with synchronization validation, covering the cpu render graph's upload, screenshot readback and present; any validation error, or a missing layer, fails the case.

name: sync_validation_hazard
description: Records two copies into one buffer with no barrier between them and expects synchronization validation to report the write-after-write, proving the sync validation cases can fail.

name: camera_nudge_return
description: Camera drag-out-and-return round trip; the evaluator FLIP-compares the before and after screenshots.

name: primitive_move
description: Moves one mesh between two screenshots; the evaluator requires a visible difference, guarding acceleration structure refits for moved primitives.

name: usd_round_trip
description: Render, export to USD, reload and re-render; the evaluator FLIP-compares the two screenshots.

name: usd_loader_semantics
description: USD scene semantics and packaged USD/glTF texture identity resolution.

name: usd_loader_semantics_rebuild
description: usd_loader_semantics under rebuild_cache: packaged artifacts must resolve when nothing can recook. Recooks from sources in a dev tree, so it stays out of coverage runs.

name: input_injection
description: Synthetic mouse and touch sequences through InputManager::Push.

name: cook_targets
description: The generated cook target table and the '+'-separated --cook_targets grammar, including the rejection of an unknown target.

name: cooker_request
description: Cooker cache-hit delivery and relocated-content contracts.

name: image_io
description: Image file content detection, channel normalization, storage sizing, and synchronous writes.

name: texture_compression
description: Block-compressed texture encode/decode invariants for every profile and family, plus source identity canonicalization rules.

name: sky_compression
description: The fp16 master sky cube (format, CPU sampling, GPU upload) and the family transcode round-trip including stats carry-over.

name: scene_load_failure
description: Scene async failure propagation for a missing authored sky resource.

name: dynamic_buffer_reuse
description: Staged buffer uploads, dynamic suballocation capacity, reuse, and adjacent free-range coalescing.

name: vulkan_image_subresources
description: Vulkan image layout tracking and readback for a selected cube face and mip.

name: pass_timestamps
description: Opt-in rendering GPU timestamps report a time once their frame slot returns, a pass recorded twice reporting its last run, and nothing without device support.

name: render_graph_compile
description: Synthetic render graphs: culling, transient image reuse within and across frames, barriers seeded from tracked state, load/store inference, the dump and draws binding their declared textures, then executed and read back.

name: render_graph_sync_validation
description: render_graph_compile under Vulkan synchronization validation, so every planned barrier batch must order the accesses it separates.

name: render_graph_errors
description: One mistake per render graph error, with errors thrown instead of aborting: declarations, imports, compile-time checks, and recording checks including bindings no pipeline has and graph resources a pipeline holds that the pass did not declare. Each must fail with its expected message.

name: render_graph_pass_timing
description: Render graph raster and compute passes dump their GPU time once their frame slot returns, and none without device support.

name: cpu_graph_shape
description: The cpu pipeline's render graph of a still frame (passes, accesses, barriers, load/store, resources), compared against its golden graph shape.

name: gpu_graph_shape
description: The gpu pipeline's render graph of a frame that traces samples into the accumulator (passes, accesses, barriers, load/store, resources), compared against its golden graph shape. Needs ray query support; without it the pipeline falls back to forward, whose graph differs from the golden.

name: forward_graph_shape
description: The forward pipeline's render graph of a still frame (passes, accesses, barriers, load/store, resources), compared against its golden graph shape.

name: deferred_graph_shape
description: The deferred pipeline's render graph of a still frame (passes, accesses, barriers, load/store, resources), compared against its golden graph shape.

name: deferred_graph_view_shape
description: The deferred pipeline's render graph while render_graph_view shows the scene depth: the depth is drawn into the screen in place of tone mapping, and the passes that only fed the scene color are culled.

name: deferred_graph_view_fallback
description: render_graph_view naming a texture the post chain cannot sample (the integer GBufferPacked) falls back to the normal frame: the deferred golden graph shape.

name: pipeline_switch_pool
description: Runtime pipeline switch and graph texture pool reuse.

name: ibl_parity
description: CPU IBL cook jobs compared against their GPU producers. Needs a physical GPU; its deliberate artifact recook would trip the suite's cook gate, so it runs only via --case.

name: smoke
description: Init and scene-load sanity check.

name: surface_loss_recovery
description: Native window destroy/restore mid-run (screen off/on driven by the android runner); the recreated surface and swapchain must reproduce the pre-loss frame. Android only.

name: nrd_probe
description: Cooked ReBLUR pipelines compile to PSOs on the current GPU. Apple platforms only.

name: denoiser_handoff
description: The convergence handoff schedule shared by every denoising provider: window bounds, the linear ramp, the final-frame pin, and the opt-out below the window.

name: denoiser_runtime_toggle
description: Runtime denoiser provider selection during and after accumulation.
